name: Kent County's Best Summer Camp and After School
description_short: A summer camp for children in kindergarten through 5th grade in West Warwick, RI, run by Cellucci's Martial Arts LLC. Each week includes indoor and outdoor sports, educational lessons, and arts and crafts.
